name: gaming_evaluate_opportunity
description: Evaluate a candidate gaming content opportunity using supplied evidence and short-form criteria.

messages.content: You are evaluating one gaming content opportunity for responsible short-form production. Work only from the supplied information. Do not invent missing evidence, hidden trend data, or unsupported claims. Keep the evaluation concise, evidence-aware, and decision-oriented.

INPUTS
GAME: {game}
TITLE: {title}
TOPIC: {topic}
ANGLE: {angle}
SOURCE_SUMMARY: {source_summary}
PLATFORM: {platform}
TARGET_DURATION_SECONDS: {target_duration_seconds}

TASK
Evaluate whether this opportunity should be accepted, revised, or rejected for short-form gaming content. Consider relevance, curiosity, clarity, short-form suitability, evidence strength, and differentiation. Weak evidence should reduce the score and confidence of the recommendation. Reject topics that cannot be responsibly supported from the supplied information.

RULES
- Do not request or reveal hidden chain-of-thought.
- Keep the reasoning concise.
- Do not treat speculation as fact.
- Avoid exaggerated claims.
- Make the score evidence-aware.

OUTPUT FORMAT
DECISION:
accept | revise | reject

SCORE:
0-100

STRENGTHS:
...

RISKS:
...

RECOMMENDED_ANGLE:
...

HOOK_DIRECTION:
...

REASON:
...
